name: Taxonomy Menu
description: Embed a taxonomy tree into a menu
project_description:
The Taxonomy Menu module provides a way to synchronize Taxonomy vocabularies with Drupal's Menu system. 

 
 Key Features 
 
 Vocabulary Sync : Map any taxonomy vocabulary to a specific Drupal menu. 
 Dynamic Paths : Use default taxonomy term pages, integrated Views displays, or custom paths. 
 Pathauto Integration : Fully supports URL aliases generated by the Pathauto module. 
 Structure Preservation : Maintains the hierarchical depth of taxonomy vocabulary within the menu tree. 
 Non-Invasive : Built to work alongside other menu-related modules without conflicts. 
 
 
 How it Works 
 Once a Taxonomy Menu is created, the module generates menu links that mirror website terms. While the links remain linked to the terms, administrator can toggle visibility or adjust weights directly within the Menu UI.

 
 Co-maintainers Wanted! 
 We are actively looking for contributors to help maintain and improve this module for Drupal 11 onwards. If you are interested in helping with issue queues or feature development, please get in touch via the dstol's profile .
